about: Official NPI release dates per sport, from each sport's 2026-27 NCAA Division II prechampionships manual (npi/manuals.json has the quotes). 'weekly' lists single release dates; 'daily' is an inclusive [first, last] range of daily releases. Read by npi.py; edited by hand or by the monthly manuals routine, then checked with `python3 npi.py schedule-check`.

Women's Soccer.basis: Manual p. 12: Oct. 12 first, Oct. 19 second, Oct. 26 daily updates begin; selections Mon. Nov. 9 (end of daily range assumed = selection day).

Men's Soccer.basis: Manual p. 12 lists Oct. 12, 19, 26; p. 17: daily pushes begin two weeks before selections (Mon. Nov. 9), so daily from Oct. 26 (implied).

Women's Volleyball.basis: Manual p. 13: Oct. 19 first NPI publication, Oct. 26 second, Nov. 2-15 daily; selections Sun. Nov. 15.
